method: Reviewed full-fact clauses replayed against actually returned text only. A clause is covered when at least one listed alternative appears (whitespace-insensitive literal substring) in a fragment from an allowed product/version. All clauses are AND.
changes_from_v2_0: manual_incomplete 的 4 组改为可复算的事实子句；说明文件修正后可直接通过，不再硬编码 false
R036-E1 的“百分比含义未解释”子句补充等价写法，并登记为依赖查询时追加的 figure_uncertainties
R037-E1/R040-E1 的时钟树分支、R052-E2 的 EEPROM 写入注意事项、R053-E2 的 Flash 缓存器说明由长字面拆为原子子句
register/table 类长字面保持整体，避免拆出通用句造成误判（拆分只用于区分度高的叙述事实）

score_semantics.clause: one independent fact requirement; all clauses must be covered
score_semantics.alternatives: equivalent literal phrasings for one clause; any one is enough
score_semantics.allowed_sources: fragment product/version must match a locator source_id in corpus.json
score_semantics.code: required_code_text must appear as complete contiguous ordered lines in one fragment
score_semantics.pending: pending_description_update clauses are expected to fail until figure descriptions are rewritten
